description: Designed for elite runner performance. Crafted in proud national racing red with quick-dry micro-mesh fabric, tailored green stitching details, and superior air flow. Features a faint tone-on-tone Greek-key heritage print across side torso.

Tailored ladies running jersey featuring our stunning signature diagonal 'Speed Sash' device in Kenya green and scarlet red. Extremely lightweight moisture-wicking weave prevents chafing and keeps you cool through half and full marathon distances.

Maximum freedom of movement for highest training efforts. Features a sleek, high-ventilation racing vest printed with our Maasai shield crest, coupled with featherweight split-cut running shorts in matte black. The gold standard for marathon trainees.

Lightweight, laser-cut women's racing singlet. Features a pristine off-white base colorway offset by the strong Kenyan visual sash detailing. Deep racerback cut offers complete arm swing freedom without friction.

Our classic crew neck performance tee in vivid scarlet red. Accented with dual-bordered speed stripes across the shoulders and a large, high-reflectivity Maasai crest emblem on the back for low-light morning runs.

Premium double set specifically optimized for long-distance durability. Includes a compression fit speed-sash top and high-performance safety pocket split shorts. Adorned with 'Born Kenyan, Born to Run' text detailing on the waistband.
